mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT station mobility has stabilized at -22% over the last three weeks, indicating a floor in commuting suppression. mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility has remained elevated at 9-13% above baseline across all four weeks, indicating sustained outdoor recreation preference. This behavioral shift crowds out indoor retail-and-recreation visits as consumers substitute toward parks, suppressing RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS mobility has remained positive and stable between 9.3 and 12.9 across all four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days rises above the last 28-day mean, or PARKS mobility falls below 5% above baseline.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above -15% over the next two weeks despite GROCERY_PHARM remaining above 5%, or GROCERY_PHARM falls below 3%.

The current elevated PARKS mobility at 9.3% will decline as weather deteriorates, forcing consumers indoors toward retail-and-recreation venues, producing a net increase in RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.

evidence_refs: fact:PARKS at 9.3% at t-0w, elevated relative to baseline
failure_condition: PARKS mobility does not decline by at least 3 percentage points over the next two weeks, or RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days does not exceed the last 28-day mean.
